name: RESET
notes: Tests primary and secondary slots for RAM and establishes SP; scans non-BIOS slots for page-1/page-2 AB/INIT cartridges and validated page-1 RBP1 payloads

name: CGTABL
notes: Points to the project-owned 8x8 boot font covering printable ASCII and the full MSX international character set 0x80-0xA3

name: VDP_DR
notes: MSX1 VDP data port

name: VDP_DW
notes: MSX1 VDP data port

name: RDSLT
notes: Reads primary or expanded slots on all four pages and restores the exact prior primary and secondary selections

name: WRSLT
notes: Writes primary or expanded slots on all four pages and restores the exact prior primary and secondary selections

name: CALSLT
notes: Calls page-1/page-2 targets with exact normal inputs in primary or expanded slots; page-0 targets switch through the page-3 CLPRIM helper and page-3 targets in another slot use a return frame in the target's page-3 RAM. Restores both selectors when the target returns

name: DCOMPR
notes: Verified by test-1983-abi-clobber: carry set when HL<DE
column8: carry clear when HL>DE; preserves BC

name: ENASLT
notes: Supports primary and validated expanded slot IDs on all four pages and updates SLTTBL

name: IDBYT1
notes: International D-M-Y 60 Hz

name: IDBYT2
notes: International keyboard and BASIC identifiers

name: VERSION
notes: MSX1 generation identifier; the MSX2 build stores 01 here

name: CALLF
notes: Parses inline primary or expanded page-1/page-2 targets without changing their normal register inputs; page-0/page-3 targets follow the CALSLT paths

name: KEYINT
notes: Runs H.KEYI then scans keyboard rows and runs VBlank H.TIMI before updating STATFL and JIFFY

name: INIFNK
notes: Fills FNKSTR with the ten default function-key strings

name: DISSCR
notes: Clears the TMS9918 R1 display-enable bit through the shadowed WRTVDP path

name: ENASCR
notes: Sets the TMS9918 R1 display-enable bit through the shadowed WRTVDP path

name: WRTVDP
notes: Accepts B=data and C=register; updates MSX1 register shadows 0 through 7 atomically

name: RDVRM
notes: Reads the VRAM byte at HL through the data port after setting the 14-bit read pointer

name: WRTVRM
notes: Writes A to VRAM at HL through the data port after setting the 14-bit write pointer

name: SETRD
notes: Sets the 14-bit VRAM read pointer from HL with the control-port pair interrupt-atomic

name: SETWRT
notes: Sets the 14-bit VRAM write pointer from HL with the control-port pair interrupt-atomic

name: FILVRM
notes: Fills BC bytes at HL in VRAM with A; count and boundary behavior covered by the VRAM probe

name: LDIRMV
notes: Copies BC bytes from VRAM at HL to RAM at DE

name: LDIRVM
notes: Copies BC bytes from RAM at HL to VRAM at DE

name: CHGMOD
notes: Dispatches modes 0-3 and provides a guarded partial Screen 7 register handoff when a live standard SUB-ROM signature is found; modes 4-6/8 remain unsupported

name: CHGCLR
notes: Screen 0 sets R7 to (FORCLR<<4)|BAKCLR; Screens 1-3 set R7 to BDRCLR; Screen 1 also fills its 32-byte color table with (FORCLR<<4)|BAKCLR; the shadow is updated

name: NMI
notes: Safe empty NMI return only

name: CLRSPR
notes: Returns in Screen 0; otherwise clears the complete 2 KiB sprite pattern table and initializes 32 attributes with Y=209/217 X=0 pattern step 1/4 for 8x8/16x16 and foreground color

name: INITXT
notes: Programs the TMS9918 for 40x24 text while preserving R1 sprite bits

name: INIT32
notes: Programs the TMS9918 for 32x24 Screen 1 while preserving R1 sprite bits

name: INITGRP
notes: Programs the TMS9918 for Graphics II while preserving R1 sprite bits
column8: and initializes deterministic empty pattern/name/color tables

name: INIMLT
notes: Programs the TMS9918 for Screen 3 multicolor

name: SETTXT
notes: Switches the live VDP to 40-column text with the current work-area tables while preserving R1 sprite bits; updates SCRMOD/LINLEN/cursor without re-initializing the tables

name: SETT32
notes: Switches the live VDP to 32-column Screen 1 with the current work-area tables while preserving R1 sprite bits

name: SETGRP
notes: Switches the live VDP to Graphics II with the current work-area tables while preserving R1 sprite bits

name: SETMLT
notes: Programs Screen 3 VDP registers R0-R6 from the MLT work-area bases

name: CALPAT
notes: Returns the VRAM pattern address for a sprite: PATBAS plus A*8 (8x8) or A*32 (16x16)

name: CALATR
notes: Returns the VRAM attribute address for a sprite: ATRBAS plus A*4

name: GSPSIZ
notes: Queries R1 without changing it and returns the current sprite-pattern size: A=8/carry clear for 8x8 or A=32/carry set for 16x16

name: GRPPRT
notes: Prints the character in A on the graphic screen at the cursor using the project font and FORCLR
column7: then advances the cursor by one 8-pixel cell; CR/LF move the cursor

name: GICINI
notes: Initializes PSG R0-R15 and the PLAY statement work area (QUEUES points to QUETAB
column8: voice static data and queues cleared)

name: WRTPSG
notes: Verified by test-1983-abi-clobber: writes E to PSG register A and round-trips through RDPSG

name: RDPSG
notes: Verified by test-1983-abi-clobber: reads PSG register A into A; WRTPSG/RDPSG round trip

name: CHSNS
notes: Reports standard circular key-buffer availability with AF as the only changed register; verified by test-1983-kbd (zero when empty

name: CHGET
notes: Blocks for one buffered character and preserves BC/DE/HL; the standard MSX cursor/edit-key codes (SPACE=20 HOME=0B INS=12 DEL=7F LEFT=1D UP=1E DOWN=1F RIGHT=1C ESC=1B TAB=09 BS=08 CR=0D) are verified by test-openmsx-keyboard; char/register/pointer behavior verified by test-1983-kbd

name: CHPUT
notes: Screen 0/1 text and Screen 2 glyph output plus backspace

name: LPTOUT
notes: Polls the printer status (port 90h bit 1) until ready or a break
column7: latches A on the data port 91h and pulses the strobe via the H.LPTO hook; returns carry clear on success and carry set after a break with LPTPOS reset

name: LPTSTT
notes: Reads the printer status via the H.LPTS hook from control port 90h bit 1 and returns A=FFh with Z clear when ready or A=00h with Z set while busy

name: PINLIN
notes: Reads keyboard input into BUFFER until Return or Ctrl-STOP with mid-line editing (cursor left/right
column10: delete); HL returns BUFFER-1 and B the count

name: INLIN
notes: PINLIN with AUTFLG set; the buffer is edited the same way but nothing is echoed

name: QINLIN
notes: Prints a question mark and space then performs INLIN

name: BREAKX
notes: Tests the physical Ctrl-STOP matrix and returns carry when both keys are held without changing interrupt state

name: ISCNTC
notes: Consumes a latched INTFLG break; carry and a cleared buffer on a break

name: CKCNTC
notes: Shares ISCNTC's break consumption

name: BEEP
notes: Short PSG channel-A tone

name: CLS
notes: Clears fixed Screen 0/1 name tables and homes the cursor

name: POSIT
notes: Stores one-based Screen 0/1 cursor coordinates without bounds checking; verified by test-1983-fnkey (CSRX=H

name: FNKSB
notes: Displays or erases the function keys according to CNSDFG; verified by test-1983-fnkey (toggle on/off)

name: ERAFNK
notes: Clears CNSDFG and the bottom text line directly without changing CSRX/CSRY; verified by test-1983-fnkey (CNSDFG=0

name: DSPFNK
notes: Sets CNSDFG and renders the FNKSTR strings on the bottom line; verified by test-1983-fnkey (CNSDFG=FF

name: TOTEXT
notes: Switches to the current text width and refreshes the function-key display; verified by test-1983-fnkey (Screen 0

name: GTSTCK
notes: Cursor keys read live and joystick ports 1/2 return standard directions 0-8 from the per-frame interrupt snapshot

name: GTTRIG
notes: Space reads live and both connector buttons return 00h/FFh from the per-frame interrupt snapshot

name: GTPAD
notes: Mouse selectors 12-19 implemented; touch panel light pen and explicit trackball detection remain pending

name: GTPDL
notes: Reads paddle 1-8 by firing the pin-8 trigger and measuring the one-shot low pulse on the PSG port-A pin; 0 with no paddle

name: STMOTR
notes: Starts/stops the cassette motor and arms the ~2s interrupt-driven auto-stop timer

name: RIGHTC
notes: Moves the cursor right; at the line end (LINLEN) it does not move

name: LEFTC
notes: Moves the cursor left; at column one it does not move

name: UPC
notes: Moves the cursor up; at the top row it does not move

name: TUPC
notes: Moves the cursor up; at the top row the text scrolls down one row

name: DOWNC
notes: Moves the cursor down; at the bottom row (CRTCNT) it does not move

name: TDOWNC
notes: Moves the cursor down; at the bottom row the text scrolls up one row

name: CHGCAP
notes: Turns the internal Caps Lock lamp on from A=00 and off from any non-zero value via keyboard PPI port C bit 6 (0 = lamp on); preserves BC/DE/HL and only AF changes

name: CHGSND
notes: Changes the key-click sound status: writes A to CLIKSW (F3DBh) with zero = click off and non-zero = click on; preserves all caller registers

name: RSLREG
notes: Reads the primary-slot register while preserving all other registers

name: WSLREG
notes: Writes the primary-slot register while preserving all registers

name: RDVDP
notes: Reads the VDP status register zero and mirrors it in STATFL

name: SNSMAT
notes: Reads active-low matrix rows 0-9 through the PPI; A returns the complement of the pressed bits (row 6 has only four keys)
column7: C holds the masked row selector
column8: and B/DE/HL are preserved; every row verified by test-openmsx-keyboard

name: PHYDIO
notes: Calls the H_PHYD hook when present; read-only-safe default reports no backend

name: FORMAT
notes: Calls the H_FORM hook when present; read-only-safe default reports no backend

name: ISFLIO
notes: Calls H_ISFL if present; read-only-safe default reports no active I/O

name: OUTDLP
notes: Calls the H_OUTD hook when present; read-only-safe default reports unsupported

name: GETVCP
notes: Returns a pointer to the active voice structure when available

name: GETVC2
notes: Returns a pointer into the voice control block by index and field offset

name: KILBUF
notes: Resets GETPNT and PUTPNT to the start of the standard 40-byte key buffer

name: SUBROM
notes: MSX2 build only. Documented push IX / jp SUBROM wrapper that calls the SUB-ROM routine in IX through EXTROM and then pops IX

name: EXTROM
notes: MSX2 build only. Calls the SUB-ROM routine at IX through CALSLT using the slot published in EXBRSA
column7: preserving the caller's alternate registers and interrupt state

name: CHKSLZ
notes: MSX2 build only. Scans primary and expanded slots for the CD SUB-ROM signature and republishes the slot in EXBRSA with carry set when found
